plugin.name: Boot_Promotion_Tracker
plugin.author: Catdad
plugin.purpose: Tracks Boot Lyceum promotion requirements via GMCP, with miniwindow
plugin.description: Boot promotion tracker + progress window. Type: promo help

trigger.match: As a reward, I am giving you (\d+) quest points

muclient.script:
require "movewindow" require "gmcphelper" -- provides gmcp() lookups via the GMCP handler
local GMCP_ID = "3e7dedbe37e44942dd46d264" -- aard package GMCP handler local gmcp_ok = false
-- promotion tiers per aardwolfboot.com/promotion-guide local RANKS = { { name = "Neo > Acolyte", days = 14, qp = 2500, cp = 30, goals = 3 }, { name = "Aco > Adept", days = 42, qp = 7500, cp = 100, goals = 10 }, { name = "Adp > Ascend", days = 90, qp = 15000, cp = 200, goals = 15 }, { name = "Asc > Savant", days = 120, qp = 50000, cp = 350, goals = 30 }, }
local function cur_rank () local n = tonumber (GetVariable ("rank")) or 1 if n < 1 then n = 1 end if n > #RANKS then n = #RANKS end return RANKS [n], n end
-- ============ window layout ============
local win = GetPluginID () local WIDTH, HEIGHT = 240, 128 local TITLE_H = 22 local ROW_H = 24 local PAD = 8 local windowinfo
local C_BG = ColourNameToRGB ("#1A1A1A") local C_TITLE = ColourNameToRGB ("#2B2B2B") local C_TEXT = ColourNameToRGB ("silver") local C_HEAD = ColourNameToRGB ("gold") local C_BAR_BG = ColourNameToRGB ("#333333") local C_DONE = ColourNameToRGB ("#3CB371") local C_PROG = ColourNameToRGB ("#CC7722")
-- ============ helpers ============
local function getnum (key) return tonumber (GetVariable (key)) or 0 end
local function setnum (key, value) SetVariable (key, tostring (value)) end
local function say (msg, colour) ColourNote (colour or "silver", "black", "[PROMO] " .. msg) end
local function days_in_clan () local joined = tonumber (GetVariable ("joined_epoch")) if not joined then return nil end return math.floor ((os.time () - joined) / 86400) end
-- ============ miniwindow ============
local function draw_row (row, label, have, need) local y = TITLE_H + PAD + (row - 1) * ROW_H
WindowText (win, "f", label, PAD, y, 0, 0, C_TEXT)
if need == nil then -- informational row: count only, no requirement bar WindowText (win, "s", tostring (have), 78 + 100 + 6, y + 1, 0, 0, C_TEXT) return end
local done = have >= need local frac = math.min (1, need > 0 and (have / need) or 0)
local bar_x, bar_w, bar_h = 78, 100, 10 local by = y + 2 WindowRectOp (win, miniwin.rect_fill, bar_x, by, bar_x + bar_w, by + bar_h, C_BAR_BG) if frac > 0 then WindowRectOp (win, miniwin.rect_fill, bar_x, by, bar_x + math.floor (bar_w * frac), by + bar_h, done and C_DONE or C_PROG) end WindowRectOp (win, miniwin.rect_frame, bar_x, by, bar_x + bar_w, by + bar_h, C_BAR_BG)
local txt = string.format ("%d/%d", have, need) WindowText (win, "s", txt, bar_x + bar_w + 6, y + 1, 0, 0, done and C_DONE or C_TEXT) end
local function draw_cp (row, need) local cp, gq = getnum ("cp"), getnum ("gq") local have = cp + gq local y = TITLE_H + PAD + (row - 1) * ROW_H local done = have >= need local frac = math.min (1, have / need)
WindowText (win, "f", "CP", PAD, y, 0, 0, C_TEXT)
local bar_x, bar_w, bar_h = 78, 100, 10 local by = y + 2 WindowRectOp (win, miniwin.rect_fill, bar_x, by, bar_x + bar_w, by + bar_h, C_BAR_BG) if frac > 0 then WindowRectOp (win, miniwin.rect_fill, bar_x, by, bar_x + math.floor (bar_w * frac), by + bar_h, done and C_DONE or C_PROG) end WindowRectOp (win, miniwin.rect_frame, bar_x, by, bar_x + bar_w, by + bar_h, C_BAR_BG)
local txt if gq > 0 then txt = string.format ("%d+%d/%d", cp, gq, need) else txt = string.format ("%d/%d", cp, need) end WindowText (win, "s", txt, bar_x + bar_w + 6, y + 1, 0, 0, done and C_DONE or C_TEXT) end
local function do_redraw () if GetVariable ("hidden") == "y" then WindowShow (win, false) return end
WindowCreate (win, windowinfo.window_left, windowinfo.window_top, WIDTH, HEIGHT, windowinfo.window_mode, windowinfo.window_flags, C_BG)
-- play nice with the package's window stacking (best effort) pcall (function () CallPlugin ("462b665ecb569efbf261422f", "registerMiniwindow", win) end)
WindowFont (win, "f", "Lucida Console", 9) WindowFont (win, "s", "Lucida Console", 8) WindowFont (win, "t", "Lucida Console", 9, true)
-- title bar (drag handle) WindowRectOp (win, miniwin.rect_fill, 0, 0, WIDTH, TITLE_H, C_TITLE) WindowText (win, "t", "BOOT: " .. (cur_rank ()).name, PAD, 5, 0, 0, C_HEAD) WindowText (win, "s", gmcp_ok and "gmcp" or "txt", WIDTH - 34, 6, 0, 0, C_TEXT) movewindow.add_drag_handler (win, 0, 0, WIDTH, TITLE_H)
local R = cur_rank () local d = days_in_clan () or 0 draw_row (1, "Days", d, R.days) draw_row (2, "QP", getnum ("qp"), R.qp) draw_cp (3, R.cp) draw_row (4, "Goals", getnum ("goals"), R.goals)
WindowShow (win, true) end
local last_draw_err = nil
local function redraw () local ok, err = pcall (do_redraw) if not ok then if err ~= last_draw_err then last_draw_err = err say ("Window draw error (report this line): " .. tostring (err), "orange") end else last_draw_err = nil end end
-- ============ GMCP wiring ============
local function gmcp_num (key) local ok, res = pcall (function () return gmcp (key) end) if ok and res and res ~= "" then return tonumber ((string.gsub (tostring (res), "[^%d%-]", ""))) end return nil end
local function gmcp_qp () return gmcp_num ("char.worth.qp") end
local function poll_qp (announce) -- Preferred: char.worth.qpearned IS the official "Qp Earned" whois stat -- (confirmed identical in testing), so read it directly. local qe = gmcp_num ("char.worth.qpearned") if qe ~= nil then gmcp_ok = true if qe ~= getnum ("qp") then setnum ("qp", qe) if not announce then say (string.format ("QP earned (from game): %d", qe), "darkgray") end end if announce then say ("GMCP linked. QP earned (official stat): " .. qe) end redraw () return end
-- Fallback: delta-track the qp balance. local qp = gmcp_qp () if qp == nil then gmcp_ok = false redraw () return end gmcp_ok = true local last = tonumber (GetVariable ("last_qp")) if last == nil then SetVariable ("last_qp", tostring (qp)) if announce then say ("GMCP linked (delta mode). QP balance: " .. qp) end redraw () return end if qp > last then setnum ("qp", getnum ("qp") + (qp - last)) say (string.format ("+%d qp earned (tracked total: %d)", qp - last, getnum ("qp")), "darkgray") end SetVariable ("last_qp", tostring (qp)) redraw () end
function OnPluginBroadcast (msg, id, name, text) if id == GMCP_ID and string.match (string.lower (text or ""), "^char%.worth") then poll_qp (false) end end
function OnPluginInstall () windowinfo = movewindow.install (win, miniwin.pos_top_right) poll_qp (true) if not gmcp_ok then say ("GMCP handler not reachable - text-trigger fallback active.", "orange") end redraw () end
function OnPluginConnect () poll_qp (false) end
function OnPluginSaveState () movewindow.save_state (win) end
function OnPluginClose () WindowShow (win, false) end
function OnPluginDisable () WindowShow (win, false) end
function OnPluginEnable () redraw () end
-- ============ text triggers ============
function promo_quest_reward (name, line, wildcards) setnum ("quests", getnum ("quests") + 1) if not gmcp_ok then local qp = tonumber (wildcards [1]) or 0 setnum ("qp", getnum ("qp") + qp) end say (string.format ("Quest #%d logged", getnum ("quests")), "darkgray") redraw () end
function promo_score_goals (name, line, wildcards) local n = tonumber (wildcards [1]) if n and n ~= getnum ("goals") then setnum ("goals", n) say ("Goals synced from score: " .. n) redraw () end end
local whois_self = false
local function my_name () local me = "" pcall (function () me = string.lower (tostring (gmcp ("char.base.name"))) end) return me end
function promo_whois_header (name, line, wildcards) local who = string.lower (wildcards [1] or "") whois_self = (who ~= "" and who == my_name ()) end
local function whois_sync (key, label, wildcards) if not whois_self then return end local n = tonumber (wildcards [1]) if n and n ~= getnum (key) then setnum (key, n) say (label .. " synced from whois: " .. n) redraw () end end
function promo_whois_qp (name, line, wildcards) whois_sync ("qp", "QP earned", wildcards) end
function promo_whois_cp (name, line, wildcards) whois_sync ("cp", "Campaigns", wildcards) end
function promo_whois_gq (name, line, wildcards) whois_sync ("gq", "GQuest wins", wildcards) end
function promo_whois_quests (name, line, wildcards) whois_sync ("quests", "Quests", wildcards) end
function promo_gq_won (name, line, wildcards) local winner = string.lower (wildcards [1] or "") local me = my_name () if me ~= "" and winner == me then setnum ("gq", getnum ("gq") + 1) say (string.format ("GQ WIN logged! (total: %d)", getnum ("gq"))) redraw () end end
function promo_cp_done (name, line, wildcards) setnum ("cp", getnum ("cp") + 1) say (string.format ("Campaign logged (total: %d)", getnum ("cp")), "darkgray") redraw () end
-- ============ report / note ============
local function req_line (label, have, need) local ok = have >= need ColourTell (ok and "lime" or "orange", "black", ok and " [DONE] " or " [....] ") ColourTell ("silver", "black", string.format ("%-22s ", label)) ColourTell ("white", "black", string.format ("%d / %d", have, need)) Note ("") end
local function report () local R, rn = cur_rank () Note ("") ColourNote ("yellow", "black", string.format ("=== Boot Promotion %d: %s ===", rn, R.name)) local d = days_in_clan () if d then req_line ("Days in clan", d, R.days) else ColourNote ("orange", "black", " [ ?? ] Days in clan set with: promo set joined YYYY-MM-DD") end req_line ("QP earned", getnum ("qp"), R.qp) req_line ("Campaigns (gq count)", getnum ("cp") + getnum ("gq"), R.cp) req_line ("Goals completed", getnum ("goals"), R.goals) Note ("") end
local function draft_note () local d = days_in_clan () Note ("") ColourNote ("yellow", "black", "--- Draft promotion note (board personal, to Boot) ---") local R = cur_rank () Note ("Requesting promotion (" .. R.name .. "). My numbers:") Note (string.format (" Days in clan: %s", d and tostring (d) or "SET JOINED DATE")) Note (string.format (" QP earned: %d", getnum ("qp"))) Note (string.format (" Campaigns completed: %d (plus %d gquest wins)", getnum ("cp"), getnum ("gq"))) Note (string.format (" Goals completed: %d - list them here (see 'goals')", getnum ("goals"))) Note ("Ready for a leader task whenever convenient. Thanks!") ColourNote ("yellow", "black", "------------------------------------------------------") Note ("") end
-- ============ commands ============
local function show_help () Note ("") ColourNote ("yellow", "black", "Boot Promotion Tracker v1.9:") Note (" promo - progress report") Note (" promo note - draft promotion-request text") Note (" promo hide / promo show - toggle progress window") Note (" promo rank <1-4> - which promotion to track") Note (" promo sync - re-check GMCP link / QP balance") Note (" promo set joined <YYYY-MM-DD>") Note (" promo set qp|cp|gq|goals <n>") Note (" promo add qp <n> | add cp | add gq | add goal") Note (" (auto-sync: type 'whois' for qp/cp/gq/quests, 'score' for goals)") Note ("") end
function promo_cmd (name, line, wildcards) local args = (wildcards [1] or "") local a, b, c = string.match (args, "^(%S*)%s*(%S*)%s*(%S*)") a = string.lower (a or "")
if a == "" then report ()
elseif a == "show" then SetVariable ("hidden", "n") say ("Window shown (top-right by default; drag by title bar).") redraw ()
elseif a == "help" then show_help ()
elseif a == "rank" then local n = tonumber (b) if n and RANKS [n] then SetVariable ("rank", tostring (n)) say ("Now tracking promotion " .. n .. ": " .. RANKS [n].name) redraw () else say ("Usage: promo rank <1-4> (1=Acolyte 2=Adept 3=Ascendant 4=Savant)", "orange") end
elseif a == "note" then draft_note ()
elseif a == "hide" then SetVariable ("hidden", "y") WindowShow (win, false) say ("Window hidden. 'promo show' brings it back.")
elseif a == "sync" then say ("Re-checking GMCP link...") DeleteVariable ("last_qp") DeleteVariable ("last_qpearned") poll_qp (true) if not gmcp_ok then say ("GMCP not reachable; text-trigger fallback active.", "orange") end
elseif a == "set" and b == "joined" then local y, m, d = string.match (c, "^(%d%d%d%d)-(%d%d?)-(%d%d?)$") if y then SetVariable ("joined_epoch", tostring (os.time { year = tonumber (y), month = tonumber (m), day = tonumber (d), hour = 12 })) say ("Joined date set to " .. c) redraw () else say ("Format: promo set joined YYYY-MM-DD", "orange") end
elseif a == "set" and (b == "qp" or b == "cp" or b == "gq" or b == "goals" or b == "quests") then local n = tonumber (c) if n then setnum (b, n) say (b .. " set to " .. c) redraw () else say ("Format: promo set " .. b .. " <number>", "orange") end
elseif a == "add" and b == "qp" then local n = tonumber (c) if n then setnum ("qp", getnum ("qp") + n) say (string.format ("+%d qp (total: %d)", n, getnum ("qp"))) redraw () else say ("Format: promo add qp <number>", "orange") end
elseif a == "add" and (b == "cp" or b == "gq") then setnum (b, getnum (b) + 1) say (b .. " count: " .. getnum (b)) redraw ()
elseif a == "add" and b == "goal" then setnum ("goals", getnum ("goals") + 1) say ("Goals: " .. getnum ("goals")) redraw ()
else show_help () end end
